Rashmi_intro.name: Rashmi
Rashmi_intro.text: You're that new tourist in town, aren't you?
Rashmi_intro.options: Doing a bit of light travel; What gave it away?

RI_T1_C1_1.name: Rashmi
RI_T1_C1_1.text: I've been there before. The inn food is always surprising. It's always better to cook your own food

RI_T1_C1_2.name: Hirani
RI_T1_C1_2.text: I'm not here to buy. Not anything you have here.

RI_T1_C1_3.name: Rashmi
RI_T1_C1_3.text: Unfortunately, all I have is what you see.
RI_T1_C1_3.options: All right; A shame, I was looking forward to more exotic items in my possession

RI_T2_C2.name: Rashmi
RI_T2_C2.text: Then you'll need to shop somewhere else.

RI_T1_C2_1.name: Rashmi
RI_T1_C2_1.text: You remind me of some people I used to know in my old life.

RI_T1_C2_2.name: Rashmi
RI_T1_C2_2.text: The kind that ran around looking for trouble.

RI_T1_C2_3.name: Rashmi
RI_T1_C2_3.text: You won't find any of that here, I promise. I've done a great deal to keep it that way.

RI_T1_C2_4.name: Hirani
RI_T1_C2_4.text: Trouble? I'm just a tourist passing through.

RI_T1_C2_5.name: Rashmi
RI_T1_C2_5.text: Then we won't have any problems.

Rueni_Intro.name: Rueni
Rueni_Intro.text: I didn't expect to see you here. Is there anything I can find for you?
Rueni_Intro.options: I didn't realize tiny towns needed librarians; I'm looking for an ancient tome

RUI_T1_C1_1.name: Rueni
RUI_T1_C1_1.text: You must live in a world where people put books back in their place.

RUI_T1_C1_2.name: Rueni
RUI_T1_C1_2.text: You didn't come all this way just to meet me, have you?

RUI_T1_C1_3.name: Rueni
RUI_T1_C1_3.text: I'm afraid I'm rather boring. These books are my home. My solace.

RUI_T1_C1_4.name: Rueni
RUI_T1_C1_4.text: I prefer their comapny over living beings so I would advise you to leave if you are not reading, as per library policy.
RUI_T1_C1_4.options: I'm looking for an ancient tome; Then I will take my leave

RUI_T2_C1_2.name: Rueni
RUI_T2_C1_2.text: Most boks here are recent, within two centuries. Most on history or fiction.

RUI_T3_C1_1.name: Rueni
RUI_T3_C1_1.text: What the council recommends and nothing more.

Kastori_intro.name: Kastori
Kastori_intro.text: Hello there. Are you looking to buy a dagger or maybe a knife?
Kastori_intro.options: No, I'm just wandering; Do you sell anything else?

KI_T1_C1_1.name: Kastori
KI_T1_C1_1.text: Must be nice to have no pressing issues to worry about.

KI_T1_C1_2.name: Kastori
KI_T1_C1_2.text: It's not often people pass by just for some old tales or a reprieve from adventuring.

KI_T1_C1_3.name: Kastori
KI_T1_C1_3.text: You know, most adventurers that come this way search for lost, ancient treasure or magic spells, unknowing that the true magic was the stories we share.
KI_T1_C1_3.options: Magic?; Not many have good stories

KI_T2_C1_1.name: Kastori
KI_T2_C1_1.text: Not the real thing, of course. I try not to mess with that.

KI_T2_C1_2.name: Kastori
KI_T2_C1_2.text: I'm going to have to change if I'm going to be a role model.

KI_T2_C1_4.name: Kastori
KI_T2_C1_4.text: When I was a different person, I did. But I sell metal now.

KI_T2_C1_5.name: Kastori
KI_T2_C1_5.text: Armor, weapons, cool necklaces. The only important things you'll need before a battle. After prayer, that is.
KI_T2_C1_5.options: Thanks. I'll come back when I need something; Nothing more... exotic?

KI_T1_C2_1.name: Kastori
KI_T1_C2_1.text: Chain, chestplates, swords, arrows, steel gauntlets.

KI_T1_C2_2.name: Kastori
KI_T1_C2_2.text: If you're brave enough I also have some leather, but I can't ensure it's quality. I didn't make it. Passing traveler did and I can't find them again.
KI_T1_C2_2.options: Thanks. I'll come back when I need something; Nothing more... exotic?

KI_T4_C2_1.name: Kastori
KI_T4_C2_1.text: What's more exotic than random leather you can't get rid of? Armor's armor.

KI_T4_C2_2.name: Kastori
KI_T4_C2_2.text: If you want something more custom, find me in five years.

KI_T2_C2_1.name: Kastori
KI_T2_C2_1.text: Not many have finished theirs either. But maybe there's a good one waiting for you to grab it.

KI_T2_C2_2.name: Kastori
KI_T2_C2_2.text: If I didn't believe in the happiness in this world, I wouldn't be married.

KI_T4_C2_1_var.name: Kastori
KI_T4_C2_1_var.text: Not right now. I've only standard gear. My free time is very slim nowadays.

R_A_1.name: Rashmi
R_A_1.text: Apples are fun when you eat them

R_A_2.name: Rashmi
R_A_2.text: I've always liked Apples, because they are lovely.

R_P_1.name: Rashmi
R_P_1.text: Pomegranates are really funny and really pretty

R_P_2.name: Rashmi
R_P_2.text: I like pome Pie and I want to eat it

R_PI_1.name: Rashmi
R_PI_1.text: Pineapples are yummy in my tummy and I will eat them.

R_PI_2.name: Rashmi
R_PI_2.text: If prinapples were nicer I wouldn't eat them

RU_Y_1.name: Rueni
RU_Y_1.text: Yogurt can be nice if you eat it fast

RU_Y_2.name: Rueni
RU_Y_2.text: Please don't eat yogurt in the library

RU_M_1.name: Rueni
RU_M_1.text: Milk is yummy. My boyfriend brings it fresh from the marsh

RU_M_2.name: Rueni
RU_M_2.text: But it spoils very easily. It usually doesn't taste good after two days outside the ice box

RU_C_1.name: Rueni
RU_C_1.text: Cheese is lovely. I try not it eat it too much.

K_C_1.name: Kastori
K_C_1.text: Bunnies eat lots of carrots, and I like that about them.

K_C_2.name: Kastori
K_C_2.text: I'm going to eat lots of carrots too

K_L_1.name: Kastori
K_L_1.text: Lettuce is strange. I don't really like it.

K_L_2.name: Kastori
K_L_2.text: But my wife makes it and I eat it.

K_B_1.name: Kastori
K_B_1.text: Brocolli is the key to these muscles.
